```yaml
name: UI Core Components Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-core-components-tests.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    paths:
      - 'openmetadata-ui/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-core-components-tests.yml'

jobs:
  test-ui-core:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: openmetadata-ui

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'yarn'
          cache-dependency-path: openmetadata-ui/yarn.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        # Note: The request mentions upgrading to 1.54.2 in workflows. 
        # This step installs the browsers matching the version in package.json (1.54.2).

      - name: Run Playwright Tests
        run: yarn test:playwright
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: openmetadata-ui/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
